description: cfd_2d_cpm_bedload_layer on the CFD mesh refinement: level 0 at 5 mm, the box G 15 over the bed (z 0-0.03 m, the whole periodic length) refined to level 1 (2.5 mm); CPM runs on the grid of level 1 over the box (its own lexer, ghostcell, fdm, decomposed by dmpart), the fluid of the patch copied onto it every step, its bed back onto the patch, restricted to level 0 (lattice seeding Q 29 1)
covers: cfd_amr::cpm_setup: the grid of CPM built in memory (gridfile_v2 writer, dmpart::build_mem, lexer::grid_inmem, ghostcell(lexer*))
cfd_amr::cpm_pull, cpm_push: the copy between the patches and the grid of CPM, the restriction of the bed, its fills, the direct forcing and the bed level of all grids
sediment_part on the grid of CPM: the bedload layer, the CPM log
